content.text:
Before I change `gen-og.ts`, there's one real blocker I can't decide for you.

**Logo + RTL are straightforward** — I can switch the wordmark to `getLogoSvg("pantoken", "horizontal", "reversed", lang)` from `@pantoken/plugin-logos` (it has `ar, el, fa, he, hi, hy, jp, ko, ru, th, uk, zh` variants), mirror the ring field to the bottom-left, right-anchor the text with `text-anchor="end"`, and loop over every locale.

**Rendering all locales' *text* needs fonts we don't have.** `resvg` runs with `loadSystemFonts: false` and only the bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible Next TTFs, which are Latin-only. Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari, Armenian, Greek, Cyrillic, Thai, CJK, and Hangul would all render as blank/tofu — which is why the current code punts to `og.png`.

- **Vendor Noto TTFs (commit them)** — fully offline and reproducible on CI, but Noto Sans SC/TC/JP/KR are ~5–10 MB each; the repo grows by roughly 40 MB.
- **Fetch Noto at build time into a gitignored cache** — no repo bloat, checksum-pinned, but `docs:assets` (and therefore CI + the docs deploy) gains a network dependency.
- **Enable `loadSystemFonts: true` as a fallback** — zero new assets, but the CJK/Thai/Armenian cards would render differently (or as tofu) on `ubuntu-latest`, which ships no CJK faces. content.text:
Every locale now renders its own social card.

**What changed**

- [docs/scripts/gen-og.ts](docs/scripts/gen-og.ts) — renders a card for all 44 locales instead of only Latin-script ones. The wordmark is read from `@pantoken/plugin-logos`' vendored assets (`horizontal-reversed`, plus each script's purpose-drawn variant) and placed as a nested `<svg>` scaled from its own viewBox, so localized marks with different aspect ratios sit correctly. RTL locales (`ar`, `fa`, `he`) mirror the whole card: ring field to the bottom-left, wordmark and text anchored right with `direction="rtl"`. Line-width estimation now ignores combining marks, and Han/kana wrap by grapheme while Hangul keeps word wrapping.
- [docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts](docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts) (new) — resolves a Noto script face per locale. The faces are ~53 MB of variable TTFs, too large to commit, so they're fetched from URLs pinned to one `google/fonts` commit, SHA-256 verified, and cached in the git-ignored `docs/assets/fonts/noto/`. If a font is neither cached nor reachable, that locale's card is still written with English text, so `og:image` never points at a 404.
- [docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts) — `ogImageUrl` is now just `og-<locale>.png` for every non-root locale.
- [docs/scripts/stage-locale-logos.ts](docs/scripts/stage-locale-logos.ts) (new, wired into `docs:assets`) — the localized nav wordmarks were hand-placed in git-ignored `docs/public/`, so a fresh clone or CI build had none. They're now copied from the same plugin assets.
- [ASSURANCE.md](ASSURANCE.md) / [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) record the new build-time fetch (T-13), plus a changeset.

`vp check` and the 211 docs tests pass, and a rebuilt site shows `og-ja.png`, `og-ar.png`, `og-zh-Hant.png`, and `og-hu.png` on their respective home pages.

Note: `l10n/*/docs.api.po` picked up PO-header rewrites as a side effect of running the docs build — unrelated to this change, so I left them for you to keep or revert.

content.text:
Fixed — `og-vi` no longer has tofu.

**Cause:** Atkinson Hyperlegible Next covers core Latin only, and Vietnamese precomposed tone stacks (`ở ọ ơ ộ ư ợ ả ế ể ữ ệ ụ`) aren't in it.

I parsed the brand face's `cmap` and checked every locale's hero strings against it. Beyond the scripts already mapped, only two locales fall outside its coverage: `vi` and `mi` (`ō`). Both now take Noto Sans for the whole card, alongside `el`, `ru`, and `uk` — one face per card rather than a mid-line switch between two. Noto Sans also picked up `syntheticBold`, since it hits the same variable-default-instance problem as the other Noto faces, so those five cards now have the intended headline and supporting-line weights.

I also left Noto Sans loaded last on every card as a safety net, so if a future translation introduces a character no mapped face carries, it renders instead of tofu — the doc comment on `LOCALE_FONTS` in [docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts](docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts) notes that as the signal to add a mapping.

Two notes: `vp check` is clean, but `docs/scripts/build-api-locales.test.ts` fails against your in-flight edit to `build-api-locales.ts` — unrelated to this work. The `l10n/*/docs.api.po` diffs are likewise from your other terminal, not from me.
